blocks.text: AUSTIN, United States — Kimi Antonelli moved to within striking distance of his first world championship title as he powered to an emphatic victory at the US Grand Prix in Austin on Sunday. It was his ninth win of the season and with his only rivals Mercedes teammate George Russell and Ferrari’s Lewis Hamilton finishing eighth and fourth respectively, the 20-year-old Italian needs just to come in ninth in next week’s race in Mexico to become the youngest ever Formula One champion.
